decision_references: Use the $500 as limited honoraria for volunteer expert work
Delivery window option A: four weeks
Honoraria allocation option 3: USD 400 core-rater completion pool plus USD 100 adjudication reserve
Use the recommended contribution, eligibility, reserve, start, payout, and attrition rules
Apply the approved operating plan to the immediate 48-critique pilot

programme_scope.scope_note: The USD 500 plan applies to the pilot. It does not fund or activate the deferred 400-critique expansion.

start_rule.calculation: Choose the earliest Monday at 00:00:00 UTC that is at least 72 hours after the operations owner signs the complete pilot readiness-gate record. Set calendar_end exactly 28 days after calendar_start.

readiness_gate: The project owner approves the recommended 12-position by four-critique structure, topic/source matrix, candidate-acquisition rule, exact controlled manifest, and protected-item exposure rules.

Rubric v2 instructions, rating form, numerical disagreement triggers, numerical scale-readiness thresholds, and adjudication protocol are frozen after methodological-adviser review and explicit owner approval.
Six early-career core raters and two dedicated adjudicators are confirmed, consented, conflict-checked, and calibrated; replacement candidates are documented.
Blind assignments are generated with two independent core raters per critique, all sibling critiques kept within the same rater pair, and no protected exposure leakage.
The operations owner signs the readiness record and payment administration plus applicable legal, tax, sanctions, and jurisdiction review are complete.
completion_gate: All 96 required blind initial ratings are accepted or validly replaced.
All cases required by the frozen adjudication policy are resolved or explicitly documented as unresolved.
Both dedicated adjudicators complete the required label-snapshot sign-off.
Rating, revision, adjudication, exposure, and payment audit records are complete.

targets_are_contingent_on: applicable legal, tax, sanctions, and jurisdiction checks complete

required_conditions: the unit is accepted by the frozen quality-control rules
the unit is accepted by the frozen adjudication quality-control rules

controls: Aggregate pilot honoraria commitments and disbursements must not exceed USD 500 unless a later owner-approved funding decision changes the ceiling.
Exactly USD 400 is reserved for the pilot core-rater completion pool and USD 100 for the pilot adjudication reserve under the current ceiling.
Every accepted unit participates after qualification; no eighty-percent or all-assignment completion threshold may be introduced without a new owner-approved decision.
The pool formula allocates capped honoraria and must not be described as a per-rating wage or as full labour-cost coverage.
The 28-day clock starts only under the frozen first-Monday rule after the complete pilot readiness gate is signed; no calendar deadline may be advertised before then.
The four-week window does not extend automatically; any extension requires a new project-owner decision and an updated audit record.
Unused adjudication-reserve funds remain unspent and may not be transferred silently to another pool.
Accepted contribution units are never forfeited solely because a contributor later withdraws or is replaced.
Public recruitment remains closed until the recommended pilot structure is approved and panel identities, payment administration, and applicable legal and tax review are complete.
The USD 500 plan does not activate, reserve funding for, or promise participation in the deferred 400-critique Phase 2 programme.
Additional funding must remain separately traceable from the initial USD 500 ceiling.
unresolved_parameters: Final owner approval of the recommended 12-position by four-critique structure and paired-rater assignment design.
Exact numerical adjudication and scale-readiness thresholds after methodological-adviser review.
Exact six early-career core-rater and two adjudicator identities, plus any prequalified replacement candidates.
Payment method, recipient jurisdictions, tax documentation, sanctions screening, and applicable legal review.
Readiness-signoff timestamp and the automatically derived absolute calendar start and end dates.
External-funding application owner, submission dates, and final target-specific evidence packet.

next_decision.question: Which recommended pilot structure and thresholds, panel and replacement identities, payment and jurisdiction arrangements, and external-funding application owner should be approved before the pilot readiness gate can pass?
